title: Sparkwing node protocol: log record
description: One line of the NDJSON log stream a node process writes to stdout. Each line is one JSON object terminated by a newline.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with fractional seconds. The host may replace it with its own receive time.

node.description: Id of the node that wrote the record. The host overwrites it with the process's node.

step.description: Id of the step the record belongs to. The host keeps it only while that step has a run_step in flight.

event.description: Empty or absent for a plain message. Values an SDK writes: node_annotation, node_summary, exec_start, exec_line and exec_end. The host writes step_start, step_end, step_skipped, work_fail_fast, node_start, node_end, retry and similar values itself, and stores an SDK record carrying one of them as a plain message.

msg.description: The message. May carry raw ANSI from a child process; the other fields never do.

level.description: The annotation's severity; absent means notice.

file.description: Repository-relative path the annotation points at.

end_line.description: Last line of the range in file.

execEnd.description: attrs of an exec_end record: per-command numbers an SDK reports when it has them. The host's own measurement of the process session is authoritative.

max_rss.description: Peak resident set size in bytes.
